mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ebus_generation_run (biz_id, user_id, hold_id, exec_hold_id, session_id, scene_id, scene_code, skill_id, artifact_ref, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{bizId}, #{userId}, #{holdId}, #{execHoldId}, #{sessionId}, #{sceneId}, #{sceneCode}, #{skillId}, #{artifactRef}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ebus_generation_run SET hold_id = #{holdId}, exec_hold_id = #{execHoldId}, session_id = #{sessionId}, scene_id = #{sceneId}, scene_code = #{sceneCode}, skill_id = #{skillId}, artifact_ref = #{artifactRef}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE biz_id = #{bizId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, biz_id, user_id, hold_id, exec_hold_id, session_id, scene_id, scene_code, skill_id, artifact_ref, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ebus_generation_run WHERE biz_id = #{id}
